import math
from collections import defaultdict

x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
g = math.gcd(x, y)
x //= g
y //= g
q = x // y
r = x % y

result = defaultdict(list)

b = 1
while b <= n:
    g = math.gcd(y, b)
    c = b // g
    z = y // g
    t = b * z
    u = q * t + r * c

    def save_ratio(a):
        g = math.gcd(a, b)
        ratio_value = abs((a - u * z) / t)
        result[ratio_value].append((b // g, a // g))

    save_ratio(u // z)
    if u % z != 0:
        save_ratio((u + z - 1) // z)
    b += 1

max_ratio = max(result.keys())
p = max(result[max_ratio], key=lambda pair: pair[1])
print(f"{p[1]}/{p[0]}")
